text:
talia: hey folks, opening my first PR today. quick checklist please: branch naming, whether to draft vs normal PR, handling generated code (openapi/protos), commit message style, and who to ping for a mentor quick-review?
hiro: welcome! branch: `feature/ENG-6302-short-desc` or `fix/ENG-6302-short-desc`. kebab-case after ticket. keep it short.
mentor-rotation: @talia you can request a mentor review by adding `mentor:needed` label or tagging `@mentor-rotation` in the PR. we'll assign someone on the rota for a quick pass.
talia: nice 44d draft vs normal?
hiro: use Draft PRs if you want early feedback and don't want autoscale CI runs; convert to Ready when tests pass. For tiny docs tweaks a normal PR is fine.
mentor-rotation: small tip: include a short "What I changed" and "How to test" section in the PR body to speed up mentor reviews.
talia: generated code question: should I include generated openapi/protos diffs?
hiro: if this repo tracks generated artifacts include them, but prefer splitting "generated files" into a separate commit with a clear header like `chore(gen): update protos (ENG-6302)`. If they are huge, open a separate PR just for generated artifacts.
preflight-bot: [preflight] Please run `./scripts/preflight.sh` locally (linters, type checks, unit tests) and ensure branch is up to date with main.
talia: commit msg style? conventional, freeform?
hiro: lightweight conventional-ish. Examples: `feat(api): add streaming header (ENG-6302)` or `fix(runtime): avoid nil deref`. Put ticket id either in subject or in the first line of body.
mentor-rotation: reviewer guidance: check CODEOWNERS first; otherwise 2 reviewers required. For infra/proto/api changes, request the relevant subteam (e.g. `@api-platform`). Security-impacting changes need `@sec-eng` signoff.
talia: merge policy? squash or keep commits?
hiro: default merge UI suggests squash for small fixes. For multi-commit features keep logical commits (don't include lots of "fixup" commits). If you keep them, make sure each commit builds.
merge-bot: [merge-bot] Reminder: add `area/*`, `type/*`, `size/*` labels and mark `needs-staging` if you want a preview deploy.
talia: CI flakes: some integration jobs hit remote services and fail intermittently. Is it ok to open PR while flaky?
hiro: open it and document flaky tests in PR body. Tag `@eng-oncall` for CI reruns. If flakiness is reproducible, file a flake ticket.
talia: thanks all, i'll open a Draft PR, run preflight, add `mentor:needed` label, and ping once it's ready for a quick pass. appreciate the help! :rocket:
